# Pore Terminology in 3D Bioprinting

An open-source reference for the parvo-, medio-, and magno- pore size classification framework used in 3D bioprinting and hydrogel scaffold design (Trifonov et al., 2024).

## Core Definitions
- parvo-pores: Interconnected pore structures with a diameter (d) less than 25 µm.
- medio-pores: Interconnected pore structures with a diameter (d) between 25 µm and 100 µm.
- magno-pores: Interconnected pore structures with a diameter (d) greater than 100 µm.

## Key Metadata
- Context: Replaces traditional chemical IUPAC macro/meso/micro terminology to fit biological scales.
- Primary Source: Trifonov et al., 2024 ("Reasoning on Pore Terminology in 3D Bioprinting")
